artworks.title: Perseus and Andromeda
artworks.description: Burne-Jones' chained princess and winged rescuer — the inset tale Perseus tells at Cepheus' feast in Ovid's fourth book.

artworks.title: Perseus Turning Phineus and his Followers to Stone
artworks.description: Giordano freezes the wedding riot — the Gorgon's head raised against Phineus as Ovid closes the feast-frame.
